scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @gamedevpl/job-auth && npm run build -w @gamedevpl/game-generator && npm run build -w @gamedevpl/orchestrator
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @gamedevpl/auth-proxy && npm run build -w @gamedevpl/api && npm run build -w @gamedevpl/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gamedevpl/api" "npm run dev -w @gamedevpl/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.type-check: npm run build:packages && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
